settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure your AI Gateway API key to enable chat functionality.
settings.providerHint: Choose which AI provider to use for generating responses.
settings.vercelApiKeyPlaceholder: Enter your Vercel AI Gateway API key...
settings.vercelApiKeyHint: Your API key is stored locally in your browser and never sent to our servers.
settings.opencodeApiKeyPlaceholder: Enter your OpenCode GO API key...
settings.opencodeApiKeyHint: Your API key is stored locally in your browser and never sent to our servers.
settings.themeHint: Choose between light, dark, or follow your system preference.
settings.appFontHint: Choose the font for the entire application. Code blocks keep their own monospace font.
settings.appFontSizeHint: Adjust the base font size of the entire application. Code blocks keep their own sizing.
settings.searchEngineHint: Choose the search provider. Native uses the model's built-in search. Tavily enables web search for all models via tool calling.

tavily.apiKeyHint: Required to use Tavily Search. Stored locally.
tavily.searchDepthTooltip: Controls the latency vs. relevance tradeoff. Advanced gives the best results but uses 2 API credits.
tavily.maxResultsTooltip: The maximum number of search results to return (1-20).
tavily.includeAnswerTooltip: Include an LLM-generated answer to the query. Advanced returns a more detailed answer.
tavily.includeRawContentTooltip: Include the cleaned HTML content of each result in markdown or plain text format.
tavily.topicTooltip: Category of the search. News is useful for real-time updates about politics, sports, and current events.
tavily.timeRangeTooltip: Filter results based on publish date or last updated date.
tavily.exactMatchTooltip: Only return results containing the exact quoted phrase(s) in the query.
tavily.chunksPerSourceTooltip: Maximum number of content chunks returned per source when using Advanced depth (1-3).

settings.deleteConfirmDescription: This will permanently delete all your chats and their attachments. This action cannot be undone.
settings.deleteHint: Permanently remove all chats and associated files from local storage.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.description: Messages you upvoted so you can find them again quickly.
favorites.emptyDescription: Upvote responses and they will show up here.

chat.welcomeTitle: Hello, I'm Keryx. How can I help you?
chat.welcomeSubtitle: Start a conversation and I'll assist you with information, analysis, coding, creative writing, and more.
chat.inputPlaceholder: What would you like to know?
chat.failedCreate: Failed to create chat. Please check your API key in Settings.
chat.unsupportedImageDescription: The selected model does not support images. Only text documents are allowed.
chat.unsupportedCloudAttachmentDescription: In cloud mode, attachments must be uploaded as embedded local files. Please reattach the file and try again.

message.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this chat? This action cannot be undone.

reasoning.expandToViewFull: Expand to view the full reasoning

dashboard.title: Admin Console
dashboard.description: Manage users, invitations, and models available to the user role from a single page.
dashboard.usersDescription: Review registered accounts and their role-based access.
dashboard.modelsDescription: Enable or disable models available in cloud mode.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: Create invitation-only accounts for cloud mode.
invitations.singleUseDescription: Invitations are single-use. You can delete them manually while pending or after they have been used.

models.title: Models
models.description: Control which models remain available to the user role. Admins always retain access to the full catalog.

users.title: Users
users.description: List current users and change their role when needed.
users.lastAdminHint: At least one administrator must always remain.

login.subtitle: Sign in to your {appName} account.
login.invitationOnly: Registration is invitation-only. Ask an admin for an invite link.

invite.title: Complete your invitation
invite.subtitle: Create your password to activate the invited {appName} account.
invite.invalidInvitation: This invitation is invalid or has already been used.
invite.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters.
